author: Claude Opus 5
scope: Measured the quantities precision_witness.SPECS pins, for the three ABCDE reference graphs that had no pinned specification: amazon, dblp, com-youtube. Run on Rachit's instruction to cover all five graphs rather than only the two clamped ones.
why_this_is_labelled: These values were measured in order to be pinned, so a pin derived from them cannot falsify the run that produced it. It establishes reproducibility and detects later corpus drift, and nothing more. It is stated because the design's inherited '3--18' degree range was presented as a prediction when no artifact recorded the measurement, and that cost a full cit-Patents run.

method.identity: SHA-256 over each complete file; edge rows by the strict two-signed-integer grammar; score rows as nonblank lines. Same grammar as the 2026-09-09 preflight.
method.topology: Distinct original ids and distinct canonical undirected edges, computed in memory (these three graphs are 38-125 MB). The production path re-derives both with the external-merge machinery and re-checks them.
method.selector: The production predicate, replicated: printed-zero score AND a first nonadjacent neighbour pair, using precision_witness's own helpers.

consistency_checks_that_hold_on_all_thre: score nonblank rows == distinct edge-file node count
parsed edge rows - self-loop rows == canonical undirected edges (so no duplicate rows)
headline: Zero structurally-positive printed zeros on all three unclamped graphs, among 3,030,420 printed zeros between them (amazon 701,532; dblp 1,678,358; com-youtube 650,530). Every printed-zero node's neighbourhood is a clique, so no nonadjacent neighbour pair exists and no printed zero contradicts a true zero. Compare the two clamped graphs, which select 662 (cit-Patents) and 1,086 (com-lj).
what_this_does_not_establish: It does not prove the three graphs are unclamped; it shows their printed zeros carry no detectable structural contradiction.
The directional test cannot catch false-NONZERO rule errors hidden among shipped zeros.
Quantisation mechanisms remain INFERRED, not established.
